final: WITH pa AS (SELECT player_id, AVG(a * 1.0 / g) AS avg_ratio FROM fielding_postseason WHERE a IS NOT NULL AND g IS NOT NULL AND g <> 0 GROUP BY player_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM pa WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(pa.avg_ratio) AS avg_player_avg, AVG(pa.avg_ratio - overall.overall_avg) AS avg_difference FROM pa JOIN overall ON overall.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE pa.avg_ratio > overall.overall_avg
